_meta.source: ICMR Standard Treatment Workflows (stw.icmr.org.in) + WHO treatment protocols
_meta.notes: dose_per_case = total units consumed per case over full treatment course

mild.description: Dengue fever without warning signs — outpatient management

ors_sachet_27g.dosing_note: 1L ORS per day for 3 days, encourage oral fluids

severe.description: Dengue with warning signs or severe dengue — inpatient

ringer_lactate_500ml_iv_bag.dosing_note: Crystalloid fluid resuscitation at 5-10 mL/kg/hr, titrate to HR and BP

chloroquine_250mg_tablet.dosing_note: 600mg stat, 300mg at 6h, 300mg daily for 2 days (total 1500mg base)

primaquine_15mg_tablet.dosing_note: 0.25mg/kg/day for 14 days (radical cure); screen G6PD before use

falciparum_mild.description: Plasmodium falciparum — uncomplicated, ACT per NCVBDC

artemether_lumefantrine_tablet_80_480mg.dosing_note: 4 tablets BD for 3 days (weight >35kg); take with fatty food

primaquine_45mg_tablet.dosing_note: Single dose gametocytocidal; do not use in G6PD deficiency

artesunate_injection_60mg.dosing_note: 2.4mg/kg IV at 0h, 12h, 24h, then daily until oral therapy possible

artemether_lumefantrine_tablet_80_480mg.dosing_note: Oral ACT to complete course after parenteral

dextrose_50pct_25ml.dosing_note: For hypoglycaemia management (common in severe malaria)

mild_moderate.description: Cholera with mild-moderate dehydration (WHO Plan B)

ors_sachet_27g.dosing_note: 75mL/kg ORS over 4h, then maintain; 1L per large watery stool

zinc_20mg_tablet.dosing_note: 20mg/day for 14 days (adults); reduces duration and recurrence

doxycycline_100mg_capsule.dosing_note: Single 300mg dose (3 capsules) — WHO recommended antibiotic for cholera

severe.description: Cholera with severe dehydration (WHO Plan C) — inpatient

ringer_lactate_500ml_iv_bag.dosing_note: 100mL/kg RL rapidly over 3h (adults); switch to ORS when can drink

mild_moderate.description: Acute Diarrhoeal Disease — outpatient ORS-based (IDSP classification)

ors_sachet_27g.dosing_note: WHO ORS: 200-400mL per loose stool, 750mL/day maintenance

zinc_20mg_tablet.dosing_note: 20mg/day for 14 days (adults); reduces episode duration by 25%

metronidazole_400mg_tablet.dosing_note: 400mg TDS for 3 days if protozoal/amoebic suspected

severe.description: Acute Diarrhoeal Disease with severe dehydration — inpatient

ors_sachet_27g.dosing_note: Transition to oral rehydration when tolerated

cefixime_200mg_tablet.dosing_note: For bacterial ADD (Shigella/Salmonella) — 200mg BD for 5 days
